headline: LLaMeRz climbs from 475th to 86th on ARC-3

sections.text: LLaMeRz gained 2.89 to reach 33.83, rising from 475th to 86th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The climb moves LLaMeRz from outside the top 100 into it. Public standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
